# 24. Speed up report loading with a SQLite index

Date: 2026-10-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Loading a report on the kiosk takes too long. [ADR 0022](0022-reports-open-in-under-three-seconds-on-the-kiosk.md) requires reports to open in under three seconds on kiosk hardware.

Mira says the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM and the report cache must never grow past 50 MB. This enduring constraint is recorded in example/mira-decisions [ADR 0024](../../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0024-report-cache-must-never-exceed-50-mb.md).

[ADR 0008](0008-the-report-cache-is-a-sqlite-file-on-disk.md) keeps the report cache in a SQLite file under data/ so it survives restarts.

## Decision

**Options considered:**
- `sqlite_index` (chosen): add an index to the existing cache storage to improve report lookup without keeping another cache of reports in process memory.
- `in_memory_lru` (rejected): consumes additional RAM on the 1 GB kiosk and adds another cache whose size and freshness must be managed.

**Recommended:** `sqlite_index`.

Keep SQLite as the report cache and index the report lookup used by the kiosk. The schema and query are not implemented in the current source, so the exact index must be selected from the actual lookup query during implementation.

## Consequences

An index adds storage and write overhead. It does not enforce the 50 MB limit by itself. Implementation must enforce the hard cap, accounting for index storage and other cache storage overhead, without transient growth past the limit; skip caching a report if it cannot fit after eviction.

Keep the 24-hour expiry from [ADR 0007](0007-report-cache-entries-expire-after-24-hours.md). Ship a tested down migration for the index as required by [ADR 0019](0019-every-database-change-has-a-down-migration.md).

Before release, verify the index improves the actual lookup on kiosk hardware against the under-three-second target, and test the size cap at capacity, including index overhead and oversized reports. Performance improvement and cap enforcement remain unverified until implementation.

This decision records the approach only; no feature or migration is implemented here.

# 24. Report cache must never exceed 50 MB

Date: 2026-10-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Report loading on the kiosk is too slow. Any performance improvement must fit the kiosk's limited resources.

## Decision

**Words:** 「FYI the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. The report cache must never grow past 50 MB.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-22

**Decision key:** report-cache-capacity

The kiosk has 1 GB of RAM. The report cache has a hard maximum of 50 MB. This constraint applies to report-cache performance work and future changes.

## Consequences

Implementation must enforce the limit; periodic cleanup alone must not allow the cache to exceed it between cleanups. Account for index storage and other cache storage overhead within the cap.

The technical choice is recorded in example/mira-app [ADR 0024](../../../mira-app/docs/adr/0024-speed-up-report-loading-with-a-sqlite-index.md). This record establishes the resource constraint; implementation is pending.
